job: Show that something small is loading with a ring, dots, bars or a text frame.
purpose: Loaders for work too small or too unpredictable to sketch. A ring goes inside controls and small panels. A braille frame or dots go beside a sentence that says what is happening. Equaliser bars show a stream receiving data. fd-pending shows an optimistic change at half strength until the server confirms it. Under reduced motion they hold still.
useWhen: A control, a small panel or one line of text is waiting on a response.
A stream is receiving data and needs a quiet live mark.
A change shows at once at half strength and settles when the server confirms.

avoidWhen.when: A whole page waiting to load: never a spinner or a box of bars in the middle of an empty page.
A page or a region whose layout is known; sketch it.
A button is busy; set aria-busy="true" on it instead of adding a spinner child.

states.name: announced
states.how: role="status" with aria-label, or the sentence beside it as the label

variants.useWhen: Inside an xs control or an inline icon slot.
The default beside a line of text or in a small button row.
In a field, a menu row or a compact panel.
In a card or a panel with room.
A larger box, as a section that is loading.
Live work the person is waiting on.
A quiet spinner that should not draw the eye.

parts.role: The ring; use data-size and role="status".
A text loader: a braille frame that cycles every 80ms, then your label.
The cycling frame, added by JavaScript.
Wraps an optimistic change; children show at half strength.
The rotation helper for an icon.
